steps.content: Cassian jogs through the corridor, stopping at the dressing room door to catch his breath. The dancers are gathered inside, lost and confused.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: What did they tell you over the comms?

steps.speaker: Selene
steps.content: To wait here for further instructions.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Run.

steps.speaker: Selene
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Get out of here. This is your last chance.
He doesn't have time to explain. His eyes scan the room and land on Sallie, huddled in a corner. He strides over to her and grabs her wrist.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Come with me. Now.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...What? I already told you, there's no way out.
She wrenches her hand free, her voice tired.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Mr. E is powerful. He has so many Sinners. He'll get rid of the bandits in no time. Then, he'll hunt down every last one of us who ran.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: It's pointless. I see that now.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Euphoria is under attack. It's the perfect cover. We can get to the lifeboats...

The situation is dire. This is no simple raid. The hallways are quiet. All the masked, high-ranking attendants and guests have vanished, while the low-level staff are left behind, completely in the dark.
The artificial ash storm, the manic Sinner guards abandoned outside, Mr. E's secret arts... No ordinary bandits could handle that.
Which means whoever's attacking now is a genuine threat to him. And when that man feels threatened, he will only...
Cassian's breathing quickens. He lowers his voice to give Sallie one final warning...

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: He's not defending. He's cleaning house.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: They've abandoned the ship. We're left behind. On purpose.
And Mr. E would have considered the risk of leaving witnesses alive. He—
Is that what you think?
The sudden voice cuts through Cassian's thoughts. He whirls around to find Mr. E standing in the doorway, wearing his usual pleasant smile.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: I heard you were looking for me, Cassian.
Cassian struggles to keep his composure. He still has the will to fight. He's been preparing for this, ready to face the most terrifying of enemies.
But when he sees the figure behind Mr. E, Cassian is still shocked.
[Fade in Milly's Portrait from Black] Style 18 for 2s

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Why...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Milly?
[Milly's portrait brightens]
